prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single custom Codex pixel-art avatar for a software agent grid. Create one high-definition square 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent background. Custom interpretation, not an official logo. Subject: the recognizable Codex blue-lavender scalloped flower/cloud emblem, with a large clear cream-white terminal greater-than chevron and underscore >_ at its center. Translate this into a charming crisp retro game sprite with bold dark charcoal pixel outlines, stepped contours and restrained flat pixel shading. Match an existing avatar set with 48-to-64-pixel logical detail, big square pixel clusters, gentle cream highlights, and readable friendly proportions. Centered frontal portrait emblem, occupying only the central 70 percent, with all corners and outer edges safely inside a circular crop. Palette: periwinkle, cobalt, lavender, charcoal and cream. No generic robot replacing the brand shape. No lettering apart from >_, no watermark, no border, no frame, no circular background, no scenery. Hard crisp pixel edges, no smooth gradients, no blur, no anti-aliasing or fuzzy texture.
